# KaTeX 0.16.22

Vendored browser distribution from the official `katex` npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.22.tgz

The JavaScript, stylesheet, auto-render extension, fonts, and MIT license are
included so the explainer can typeset equations without a network connection.
Keep these files from the same release when updating KaTeX.

Write inline formulas between `\(` and `\)`, and display formulas between
`\[` and `\]`. Add `typeset` to a `.math` container for display equations.
Code listings are excluded from automatic rendering.
